_readme: The homepage. Edit this, drop images in public/home/, and the page updates
— no code change needed. Same pipeline as content/about.json.
EVERY PHOTO NEEDS A CREDIT. The `credit` field renders next to the image and
again in the colophon. A photo with no credit still renders, but the build
prints a warning, because shipping someone's photograph uncredited is the one
thing this project cannot do.
LOADER: loader.objects[] are overhead shots of FOOD — bowls, plates, a glass
from above. Round subjects, centred, identical zoom, so nothing jumps inside
the letter O. loader.portrait is the ONE photograph of Bourdain: it appears
once, at the end, when the count lands. Do not put him in objects[].
POOLS: hero.photos[] and hero.quotes[] are pools — one of each is chosen at
random per visit, so the page is never the same twice. Same for pairing.
Sections left empty render as marked gaps rather than disappearing.
PULLBACK: the set-piece under the hero quote. pullback.videoId is the
11-character id from a YouTube URL (youtube.com/watch?v=THIS-BIT) —
OFFICIAL UPLOADS ONLY, same rule as cities.video_url. It autoplays muted
while the section is on screen and pauses off it; the SOUND pill is the
only way to hear it. pullback.start is optional seconds to skip in.
pullback.vertical: true for Shorts/9:16 clips — a full-height vertical
frame instead of a 16:9 cover crop.
NOTE: the video must allow embedding — many fan edits don't (YouTube
error 150, usually music claims). The player degrades to a marked card
if so, and scripts/pullback_acceptance.mjs will fail on it loudly.
pullback.background is the full-bleed photograph of the room behind the
shrinking frame — same pipeline as every other photo (file in
public/home/, credit REQUIRED). Both render as marked gaps until set.

portrait.alt: Anthony Bourdain, arms crossed on a table, looking into the camera
